dash.traceHtml: Traceability. Data from the Excel exports and PDF dashboards provided, from 29 July to 5 August 2026. The total of 11,654 corresponds to the rows of the three consolidated corpora. The relational graph uses 9,002 unique URLs after deduplicating overlaps between corpora and excluding Wikipedia and Wiktionary. Strong mentions come from the “Favourites/Tags” selections and link to their source URL. Reach is an estimate provided by the monitoring tool.

graph.p1: The <bdi dir="ltr">Political Narrative Graph</bdi>, a relational map of narrative dynamics, brings together the interactions between parties, political figures, the main political narratives and the dynamics of public opinion. It gives an overall reading of the balance of power and highlights the convergences, oppositions and influences that shape the political debate.
graph.p2: It is computed by co-occurrence across 9,002 unique URLs. Link thickness reflects frequency, and colour indicates the dominant tone or an explicit affiliation.
graph.whyHtml: Why 9,002 and not 11,654? 11,654 is the total number of rows across the three corpora. The graph relies on 9,002 unique URLs after deduplicating overlaps and excluding Wikipedia and Wiktionary.
graph.hint: Drag to explore · scroll to zoom
graph.noteHtml: Total co-occurrences displayed. In a node tooltip, this total adds up the frequencies of all its visible relations. It is neither an influence score nor a voting intention.
graph.tipDisclaimer: A sum of frequencies, not a score.

method.intro: Every day, millions of public data points are turned into decision intelligence through AI, human analysis and a proprietary methodology.
method.ibdnP1: The IBDN® (Buildfluence Narrative Dynamics Index) measures, day after day, the ability of a party or a political figure to occupy, influence and shift the Moroccan information space, based on open data from the press, media, social networks and institutional sources.
method.ibdnP2: It combines eight complementary dimensions into a score normalised out of 100, recalculated daily. The formula and the weightings remain proprietary in order to preserve the methodological integrity of the index.
method.principle: The IBDN® describes a presence and a momentum within public debate. It never measures voting intention and is neither a poll nor an electoral prediction.
method.out1Sub: A clear, factual reading of public debate.
method.ethicsTitle: What the index measures, and what it does not.
method.ethicsText: Open sources, human quality control, a stated observation period and explicit limitations. The leaders’ tone balance will be added once the dedicated query is available, and no provisional value will be invented.

about.h1Html: Making political dynamics readable, verifiable and useful.
about.intro: Buildfluence is building a sovereign Moroccan strategic intelligence infrastructure. The platform turns open data into shared understanding, without micro-targeting or voter profiling.
about.c1Text: A factual, non-partisan and methodologically traceable reading.
about.c2Text: A platform designed in Morocco, serving the understanding of Morocco.
about.c3Text: Open data, CNDP and GDPR compliance, permanent human control.
about.quote: “Data tells what happened. Relationships explain why. The IBDN® reveals what is changing.”
